// Package unformatted holds shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the house's testdata cannot hold: doubled parentheses
// around the other side and the constant, and comparisons written without spaces, whose fixes are rendered.
package unformatted

func unformatted() {
	var x, y bool
	var a, b int
	_ = ((x)) == true // reported, the render printing the parentheses as gofmt does
	_ = (((y))) != true // reported
	_ = x == ((true)) // not reported: the constant is parenthesized
	_ = x==false // reported
	_ = ((a<b))==false // reported
	_ = !!(!y)==false // reported
}
